name: The Max Foundation
what_they_do: Helps people with some chronic cancers get access to donated medicines through partner programmes.
how_it_reaches_you: Through partner hospitals and patient access programmes.

name: Gavi
what_they_do: Helps countries provide vaccines, including the HPV vaccine that can prevent most cervical cancer.

name: IAEA Rays of Hope
what_they_do: Helps countries get radiotherapy equipment and training so more people can be treated closer to home.
how_it_reaches_you: Through national hospitals and cancer centres chosen by governments.

name: American Cancer Society with Clinton Health Access Initiative
what_they_do: Works with countries so more people can get quality cancer medicines at a lower cost.
how_it_reaches_you: Through ministries of health and public hospitals.

name: UICC
what_they_do: A global network of cancer organisations that shares knowledge and supports national cancer control.
how_it_reaches_you: Through member organisations, hospitals, and cancer societies in your country.

name: AORTIC
what_they_do: An African network of cancer professionals working to improve cancer care, research, and training across the continent.
how_it_reaches_you: Through African hospitals, researchers, and professional meetings.
